decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch that fits the existing water-infrastructure portfolio and can be supported by current sales and engineering resources, it is likely kept for further market learning, though its limited website prominence suggests a moderate risk if early results fall below aspiration levels.

This product closely matches the firm's strategic move toward digitally networked, efficiency-oriented infrastructure and, given firm growth and available R&D slack, management would likely tolerate some early uncertainty rather than withdraw it quickly.

A dedicated webpage and several models indicate stronger commitment and broader expected demand within the firm's core offer, so unless performance is clearly below aspiration it is very unlikely to be taken off the market soon.
